title.en: Doumo, Akuyaku ni Sareta Reijou desukeredo
Koi ni Koisuru Koushaku Reijou no Kojirase Renai
Konyaku Haki wo Shita Reijou wa Gaman wo Tomemashita
Gishi no Kawari ni, Yomei Ichinen to Iwareru Koushaku Shisoku-sama to Konyaku suru Koto ni Narimashita
"Jimide Tsumaranai" to Suterareta no de, Jimichi ni Renkinjutsushi wo Mezashimasu!
Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Toraretara Mishiranu Koushaku-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Konyaku Haki Shita Aite ga Mainichi Shazai ni Kimasu ga, Fukuen Nante Zettai ni Ariemasen!
Ouji, Konyaku Haki Shita no wa Sochira na no de, Kowai Kao de Kocchi Niramanaide kudasai
Konyaku Haki no Tsugi wa Gisou Konyaku. Sate, Sono Ji wa...
Kono Ai wa, Kokuou Heika no Gomeirei Janai - Ohitori-sama Kibou no Reijou desu ga, Funaka na Kishi ga Hanashitekuremasen!
Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
Migawari Konyaku Shananoni, Gin Ookami Heika ga Doushitemo Hanashite Kuremasen!
Gimai ga Seijo dakara to Konyakuhaki Saremashita ga, Watashi wa Yousei no Itoshigo desu
Binbou Kishi ni Yomeiri Shita Hazu ga!? Yajin Reijou wa Koutaishihi ni Natte mo Ryuu wo Karitai
Hakoiri Koujou wa Shikou no Koi wo Onozomi desu! - Risou no Tonogata wo Sagasu Tabi ni Demasu. Tadashi, Utsukushisha Igai Mitomemasen!?
Ochikobore Reijou wa, Koushaku Kakka kara no Dekiai ni Kizukanai ~Konyakusha ni Shimeisareta no wa Saishoku Kenbi no Ane de wa Naku, Watashi deshita~
Shitataka Reijou wa Dekiaisareru ~Ronpashimasu ga, Konna Watashi Demo yoi desu ka?~
